title: Cardinals, WR Michael Wilson agree to reported 3-year, $75 million extension

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Cardinals, WR Michael Wilson agree to reported 3-year, $75 million extension
sources.description: With 78 catches for 1,006 yards and 7 touchdowns last season, Wilson moved ahead of former first-round pick Marvin Harrison Jr. on Arizona's receiver depth chart.
